annotations.text:
CLIENT V2 — same IA, image-forward composition
Hero production card (image fills the card, status overlays ON the image, not beside it) + an "up next" stack, then an image-led filmstrip with a discrete stage track (not a generic progress bar) instead of table rows. A proof-sheet grid for ready-to-download. The order log is kept but demoted to a quiet, small-thumbnail strip at the bottom — deliberate contrast against the vivid production area above it, not removed.

ADMIN V2 — a real production board, not a table
Unassigned orders as an intake strip with thumbnails, then a kanban-style board with one column per real status (In progress / Ready for QA / Revision / Delivered) — each card carries its image. This is the core structural change from V1: admin now visually reads as a production workflow, not a list of database rows. Workload/customer/insights kept compact in the sidebar; the dashed Insights panel still states plainly what isn't built.
